newsitem.title: USA: API shows lackluster propane and ethane builds.
newsitem.headline: API shows lackluster propane and ethane builds.

text.p: U.S. propane stocks rose a scant 2.5 million barrels last month to a current total of 49.46 million as of August 31, traders said Friday.
In the American Petroleum Institute report late Friday, the 49.46 million barrels is 6.98 million barrels below levels last year.
Among the biggest hubs hit, was the U.S. Gulf Coast, which showed an unexpected 137,000 barrel draw to 12.18 million barrels, traders said.
The Midwest registered a 1.4 million barrel build to a current total of 15.61 million barrels.
Drawing much concern were ethane inventories, which showed a 483,000 barrel draw from July 31 to Aug 31 to a current total of 16.89 million barrels, traders said.
